name: Mohamed Waleed Ezzat
headline: AI/ML Engineer - Agentic AI & LLM Systems
summary: Business-minded Computer Science graduate who bridges data, AI, and stakeholder needs. Built ETL pipelines and BI dashboards for business decisions during a Power BI internship, and independently shipped multiple AI applications, including a multi-agent BI copilot used to flag revenue leakage. Comfortable moving between technical execution and business communication, with hands-on exposure to LLMs, Agentic AI, and GenAI applied to real commercial problems. Eager to rotate across Product, Pre-Sales, and Delivery to see how Enterprise AI creates value end to end.

experience.role: AI Developer and SaaS Product Designer
bullets: Design and build AI-powered SaaS products for clients end to end, from product scoping and UX flow through backend architecture and AI integration, translating client business goals into shipped features.
Deliver full-stack AI applications (Python/FastAPI backends, React/Next.js frontends) as a solo freelancer, managing client communication, timelines, and iteration based on feedback.

Built ETL pipelines and data models with SQL and Power Query, and prototyped deep learning forecasting models in PyTorch, translating raw data into interactive dashboards non-technical stakeholders used for decisions.
Wrote DAX and SQL calculations to ensure accuracy across KPI and sales-trend reporting presented to business stakeholders.
Completed a self-paced consulting simulation applying Python and statistical methods to derive actionable business insights from client data, including stakeholder mapping and dataset preprocessing.

projects.name: Recovera - Multi-Agent AI and BI Copilot
projects.tech: Python, FastAPI, Next.js, PostgreSQL, LangChain, Docker
bullets: Built a production AI system letting business users ask plain-language questions and get secure, business-ready analytics back, no SQL required, via a multi-agent pipeline (planner, SQL generator, validator, executor, analytics interpreter).

Applied unsupervised anomaly detection (Isolation Forest and Local Outlier Factor) across approximately 298,000 orders to flag revenue leakage, tying an AI technique directly to a measurable commercial outcome.

Designed a PostgreSQL and pgvector schema for retrieval-augmented generation, and added a code-layer SQL validator (sqlglot and policy engine) so AI-generated queries stay safe at business scale; deployed end to end (Hugging Face Spaces, Vercel) with LangSmith tracing.

projects.name: Vector - AI Personal Assistant
projects.tech: Python, FastAPI, React, LangChain, PostgreSQL, Docker
bullets: Developed an autonomous agent that selects between web search, document analysis, and other tools based on user intent, streaming its reasoning transparently, supporting the kind of trust and explainability that matters when selling AI to enterprise clients.

projects.name: Advanced RAG Pipeline
bullets: Built an end-to-end retrieval-augmented generation pipeline with source citations and streaming responses, reducing hallucinations so business users can trust AI-generated answers, a key adoption barrier for Enterprise AI.

projects.name: Telecom Churn AI Assistant
projects.tech: Python, FastAPI, Streamlit, XGBoost, Hugging Face
bullets: Paired an XGBoost churn-prediction model with a natural-language chat interface so business users could query customer-retention risk directly, tuned with SMOTE and GridSearchCV to approximately 80 percent recall, a telecom-relevant use case.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Transformer from Scratch
bullets: Engineered a transformer from scratch, including tokenizer, self-attention, and a full training/inference pipeline, to build first-principles understanding of the LLMs behind today's Agentic AI and GenAI products.
